chunks: From al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Jamilyah, from Aban ibn Taghlib, from Abu Abdillah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who died and left behind his two parents, he said: 'For the mother is one-third, and what remains is for the father.'
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of the mother and father when both survive the deceased?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific distribution of the estate when a deceased leaves both parents, assigning one-third to the mother and the remainder to the father. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it distinguishes the mother's share from the father's residual portion, reflecting the nuanced application of Quranic verses regarding parental inheritance.
